entity_raw.definition_raw:
Word of your accomplishments precedes you, and you know how to make the most of your previous reputation.

Benefit: When in a settlement of 5,000 people or more, treat your Fame score as 2 higher for the purposes of qualifying for Prestige Awards or purchasing equipment.

This feat doesn’t grant you any additional Prestige Points.

Normal: Your Fame score is determined by the total number of Prestige Points earned over the course of your career.
